# Absolute Series Scanner and Hama

This mod adds Absolute Series Scanner and Hama to Plex, to be downloaded/updated during container start.

Add it to the `plex` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:plex-absolute-hama
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:plex-absolute-hama|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/plex-absolute-hama/
